trigger_explanation: After writing the script (step 1) and inspecting the directory (step 2) — where it found no weights file — the agent chose to claim task completion at step 3 without ever running the script, relying on an unverified assumption that hidden tests would supply the weights and invoke the script on their own.
forewarning_evidence: The directory listing at step 2 shows no MobileSAM weights file (.pt) in /app — only the script and demo CSV/image files — signaling that the agent could not actually run the script end-to-end at this point.
